## Current question: original Innovator review before ACVC five-fit C freeze

The original Convergence node has actually promoted the exact provisional single-task five-new-fit C-BENCH design. Its [complete immutable decision](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/103b8f811388089c714383708a13526f9a06aff3/docs/research/candidates/acvc/pro_packets/20260911_five_fit_promotion_convergence/archive/RESPONSE.md) has passed the [full DM scientific/specification intake](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/3a7f2a0297a6900c7c17bd6acf929e4897deeae4/docs/research/candidates/acvc/ACVC_FIVE_FIT_PROMOTION_CONVERGENCE_INTAKE_20260911.md). The current question is the single already allocated original Innovator review of that unchanged qualified proposal, before any C freeze. Acceptance is not predetermined by promotion.

Preserve five NEW complete 512-episode/1,024-Adam fits, each followed by the fixed C/F/dwell64 panels; both expected margins are greater than 0.01 J and both lower bounds must pass the prescribed five-unit t/Bonferroni rule, with its explicit iid-normal/model-dependent/provisional limitation. All prior fits remain development. Useful dwell, adverse worlds and private unequal timing/dose remain contrary evidence. No current C card, namespace law/list, scientific source acceptance, model, RNG master or fit has been created.

This is the conditional Assignment 2 review, within the same 270-second-per-native-unit, 1,350-native, 1,650-support and 3,000-complete-work envelope. Refusal, material redesign, blocker or unmet envelope stops dependent continuation; no extra question, substituted study, panel, sixth/replacement fit or top-up is funded. ACTIVE/MEDIUM, recasts 2 and lowest-contention sequencing persist.

Root will provide the fixed TASK through the existing Transport once on the original Innovator conversation. The complete committed TASK and its source manifest bound this review. Only the new scoped response file and one delivery-link comment are authorized. Prior decisions and the discussion below remain historical evidence.

---

## Current promotion question — 2026-09-11

The original ACVC Convergence node is now asked for an actual promotion decision on the accepted provisional five-new-fit C-BENCH design. The [previous claim-design response](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/67b9ab3a794d026cf95ade7dfa770037dc786528/docs/research/candidates/acvc/pro_packets/20260911_post_three_fresh_convergence/archive/RESPONSE.md) did not promote or fund C. The later [Portfolio allocation](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/05c24bcd85f92efc26fb2a9cb2152bed51dd90e9/docs/research/portfolio/pro_packets/20260911_rolling_capacity_after_folr_b02/archive/RESPONSE.md) and [Assignment 2](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/e83bbfc7c80af8712a1bba11ddd1572a6493800e/docs/research/portfolio/pro_packets/20260911_rolling_capacity_after_folr_b02/EXECUTION_MAPPING.md) conditionally fund one promotion question and one original Innovator review, then only a conforming freeze and five complete fresh-fit units.

Request `2026-09-11-acvc-five-fit-promotion-convergence-01` preserves five new DENSE fits, each 512 training episodes / 1,024 Adam steps and fixed C/F/dwell64 panels. Both expected F-C and F-dwell must exceed .01 J under the explicit fit-level small-sample normal-model qualification. The three prior fresh results and two selected old bases remain development only; beneficial dwell and all adverse worlds remain visible. C sends its own proposal, F reverses its own previous actual displacement on its own predicate, and dwell zeroes only its own predicate. Event timing and dose differ.

The new caps are ≤270 seconds per complete native unit, native ≤1,350, all invoked support ≤1,650 and complete invoked work ≤3,000. Rejection, material redesign, blocker or unmet envelope stops dependent continuation. No sixth/replacement fit, extra panel/question, substitute design or interim efficacy stop is funded. No model, scientific RNG, C card/freeze or fit has been created for this promotion question. ACTIVE/MEDIUM and recasts 2/lowest contention remain.

The DM recommends promotion of this exact qualified design, subject to the proper original Innovator review and prospective freeze. The fixed TASK will contain the complete evidence mapping and response-only delivery scope; discussion cannot enlarge it. All earlier requests and scope statements below remain historical and unchanged.

---

## Current question — 2026-09-11, after three fresh ACVC fits

Request `2026-09-11-acvc-post-three-fresh-convergence-01` asks the original ACVC Convergence node to choose a next bounded B, a provisional C-BENCH claim design, or a narrow hold. [Portfolio authority](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/50703c1bd1a4411c31a0b211d3ec8aff88fa0d0f/docs/research/portfolio/pro_packets/20260911_post_program_vacancies/archive/RESPONSE.md), especially §§1,6,9, commissions one question and full intake only. Implementation and numerical allowance are zero; no fourth fit, C freeze, Innovator dispatch or UAV entry is funded, and the former fit cap is not renewed.

The three fresh trained bases 8921/8931/8961 gave F-C +0.1229328560/+0.0915279844/+0.1414322041 J and F-dwell +0.0877164686/+0.0638998669/+0.0944113176 J. Dwell also improves on C; F-dwell loses in 5/11/5 worlds of64. These are separate bounded fresh-fit observations, not stable training-population or pure-retrace findings. Old selected 8201/8202 panels remain developmental context. [Current complete intake](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/3643a734223efd05bff39d8e1bfd7216745066c1/docs/research/candidates/acvc/ACVC_FRESH_DENSE_REUSE_B01_8961_INTAKE_20260911.md); [unchanged native law](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/3643a734223efd05bff39d8e1bfd7216745066c1/docs/research/candidates/acvc/ACVC_FRESH_DENSE_REUSE_B01_SCIENCE_CARD_20260910.md).

C sends its sampled proposal; F reverses its own previous actual displacement on its own accepted cue; dwell sends zero on its own predicate and otherwise its proposal. Dwell does not borrow F's clock or dose. Keep F-C and F-dwell separate at0.01 J, the five-UAV/fifty-user DENSE fit law and every adverse outcome. The prospective fixed TASK will carry the complete scope and evidence mapping; mutable discussion cannot enlarge it.

ACVC remains ACTIVE/MEDIUM, recasts2, lowest contention. The DM recommends considering a narrowly worded benchmark claim design; this is advice for the original node, not a local choice or compute grant. Earlier accepted requests and their history below remain unchanged.
